findings.finding: The step confinement judges a DECIDED item's proposed text on its own, not the amended text, so it accepts items that open blocks or move step boundaries, against the README's 'no item may touch another step' and 'no DECIDED item may open a new step, paragraph, heading, list item or quote'. Ten fully consistent records (section 14 re-rendered, effective text recomputed, digest re-pinned) pass v4's check(read): B1 H1 = W3's last line 'allows `setgroups`.' with a trailing line feed added, which puts a blank line (a new paragraph) before W4; B2 H2 = W4's last line with its line feed dropped, which joins W5's step line onto W4, so the effective text has no 'W5. ' line; B3-B5 an H1 whose current starts at column 0 (line 480) with a proposed first line '> ...', '- ...' or '## ...' (the first line is never tested); B6 a later line ' - ...' and B7 '   ### ...' (CommonMark allows up to three spaces before a block start; BLOCK_START anchors at column 0); B8 a later line '---' (a setext underline: the paragraph above becomes a heading); B9 '```' (a code fence); B10 '<!--' (an HTML block that hides what follows). The c1 record itself is unaffected: its H1-H3 open nothing and v4 accepts it (probe A0), and the column-0 later-line cases A4-A9 are refused as stated. The rules ask this round to show these refusals (Q-CB-4, MON-EV12-MERGE); v3's row items could not reach a junction because they were single-line, so this is new with v4's multi-line step items.
findings.requiredChange: Make the model enforce the stated rule on the amended text, for example: (1) current and proposed agree on a leading and a trailing line feed (or neither may hold one); (2) the block-start test applies to the proposed's first line whenever the current starts at a line start without a step label; (3) BLOCK_START covers CommonMark's paragraph-interrupting starts: up to three leading spaces before '-', '*', '+', '>', '#' runs, ordered markers and 'Wn.', setext and thematic lines of '=', '-', '*' or '_', '```' and '~~~' fences, and '<' HTML starts; or, stronger, check the effective text directly: §5.4's step lines are exactly W1 to W6 in order at line starts, with no blank or block-start line from W1 to W6's last line. Add B1-B10 as model probes, and list them for the D5a oracle. Narrowing the README and docstring claims instead is not recommended, since MON-EV12-MERGE asks for these refusals.
